format: HTML with embedded CSS and JavaScript
description: A web page implementing a to-do list application with HTML structure, CSS styling, and JavaScript for functionality including local storage persistence.

methods.name: LoadList
methods.description: Loads to-do items into the UI from stored data.

methods.name: addToDo
methods.description: Adds a new to-do item to the list in the UI.

methods.name: completeToDo
methods.description: Toggles completion status of a to-do item.

methods.name: removeToDo
methods.description: Removes a to-do item from the list.
